parts.name: Hour Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the hour hand of a clock, made of brass, typically around 10 cm long and 1 cm wide.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the hour on the clock face by rotating slowly around the center axis.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about the central pivot once every 12 hours.

parts.name: Minute Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the minute hand of a clock, made of brass, typically around 15 cm long and 0.8 cm wide.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the minutes on the clock face by rotating around the center axis.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about the central pivot once every hour.

parts.name: Clock Surface
parts.Basic_description: This is the main surface or dial of the clock, made of plastic, approximately 30 cm in diameter and 0.5 cm thick.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the background for the clock hands and displays the hour markers.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and supports the rotating hands.
